entries.696b1ed0dbe10f06: It has set a medium-term management plan with fiscal 2027 as its final year, and its key targets are expanding wallet share in the dispensing field, expanding market share in the medical field, and achieving profitability in the nursing care and welfare field. Its long-term vision is “Creating Synergies through Collaboration between Medical and Nursing Care,” and it positions the plan period as “building a strong foundation” toward realizing that vision. By business, it states that it will pursue expanded optional management functions and optimized pricing in the Dispensing System Business; product development leveraging cloud strengths and expansion of its agency network in the Medical System Business; and expansion of its service lineup and improved operational efficiency in the Nursing Care and Welfare System Business. The policy also includes administrative responses leveraging more than 40 years of know-how in medical DX, and active consideration of M&A and alliances.
